featured_reviews.name: Pankaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Fishermen's Deck in Vasai and had an absolutely fantastic seafood feast! The crab masala was the star of the meal—fresh, meaty, and cooked perfectly in a rich, flavorful coastal-style gravy. Every bite tasted authentic and packed with spices.
The fish fry was equally impressive—crispy on the outside, juicy and fresh inside. You can genuinely tell that they use fresh seafood, which makes all the difference. The rice, bhakri, and accompaniments complemented the dishes perfectly.
If you're a seafood lover, this place is definitely worth visiting. Great taste, generous portions, and fresh catch cooked the right way. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic seafood in Vasai! 🦀🐟🌊

featured_reviews.review_text:
While on a long drive in Vasai, we stumbled upon this cute little restaurant all decked up for ChristmasFisherman’s Deck and immediately hopped in. Seafood lovers, this is a must-try spot!

We tried:

Kokum Drink – not entirely authentic but tasty, like the bottled version

featured_reviews.name: Joseph Nunes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had high expectations from Fishermen's Deck given its seafood focus, but the experience was far from pleasant. The restaurant barely lives up to its name. Here’s why:

Food Quality: The seafood tasted stale and lacked freshness. For a place that claims to specialize in coastal cuisine, this was a huge letdown.

Service: Extremely slow and inattentive staff. Even basic requests took ages to fulfill.  They are not even positive of the water they provide and asked us to buy the bottled water - no regular water is served here.

Ambience: The interiors felt cramped and poorly maintained. Definitely not the cozy, elegant vibe they advertise.

Value for Money: At an average cost of ₹1400 for two, the quality and quantity were nowhere near worth the price.  Even the slices of Surmai fish were like sliced so thin, that you couldn't even get a mouthful.

Overall Rating: With an average rating of just 2.6/5 on review platforms, my experience sadly confirms why it’s rated so low

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.review_text:
The food was undoubtedly excellent and one of the best aspects of the dining experience. Every dish was flavorful, well-prepared, and worth the wait—if only the service had matched the quality of the food.

Unfortunately, the service was one of the worst I have experienced. Every time we asked about the status of our order, we were repeatedly told that the food would be ready in "5 minutes." This response was given multiple times, which turned out to be completely misleading. After waiting for over 20 minutes with no food served, we finally asked for the bill and decided to leave. Ironically, only then did the staff suddenly seem ready to bring out the food.

The lack of transparency, poor communication, and disregard for customers' time was extremely frustrating. It felt as though we were being given false updates rather than honest information about the delay. If there were an option to rate the service below 1 star, I would gladly give it a 0.

It's disappointing because the food itself was great, but the overall experience was ruined by the unprofessional and disorganized service. Management should seriously address these issues, as good food alone cannot make up for such an unpleasant customer experience.

Dear Ryan,

I sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused. I will personally look into the matter and ensure it is resolved promptly.

Thank you for your feedback. We have been struggling with our cooking staff for a while now, though this is by no means an excuse for the service you received.

Once again, I’m truly sorry for the experience. We hope to welcome you back soon and make it right.

Best regards,
Kokum

Despite the restaurant being half empty, the staff refused to give us a standard table for two stating its only for groups of 4-5 people. Instead, they tried to shove us onto tiny "kiddie tables" that were completely uncomfortable and insulting. When we questioned this, we were told the regular tables were "reserved," yet we watched other couples seated at similar "reserved" tables for groups comfortably.
The waiters are incredibly rude and lacked any sense of basic hospitality. I’ve noticed in the past that the service at Marina Harbour is always delayed, but I overlooked it for the sake of the ambiance. However, being outright insulted and treated like a second-class citizen is where I draw the line.
If you are looking for the best bars in Vasai or a place with decent service, stay far away from here. There are plenty of other restaurants in Vasai that actually respect their customers and don't lie about reservations just to power-trip over seating arrangements.

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Bhowad
featured_reviews.review_text:
We leave this restaurant on one note - It's a beautiful location and the ambience & the service was impeccable. And thus, sipping drinks and just sitting leisurely in the free flowing sea breeze, becomes an enjoyable experience. The service team provides attention to the smallest details, like putting leftover beer in an ice bucket, serving you hot food if it has gone cold while waiting, cleaning up your tables without having to ask.. We requested to change tables due the rains, they obliged without complaints. Wonderful experience! But when it comes to the food - the story is different.

Fish fingers, French Fries, Paneer Crispy, Masala Papad, Chicken Lazeez and assortment of breads. This was what we ordered and this is what we felt - Fish Fingers smelled strongly. They were crispy, but with strong fish smell. Fries were soggy within 5 minutes and they lacked salt. It would be great if the restaurant could change whatever ketchup they are using with the Fries. The mayonnaise they serve with Fish Fingers was very tasty though. Paneer Crispy had only taste - schezwan. I did not like the fact that my Bhakari was cooked on a grill. Chicken Lazeez reeked strongly of black pepper. I have no idea why spicy equals black peppery in most of the restaurants.

Please take this feedback constructively since you are running such a beautiful place and it can be made more beautiful if there is improvement in the food. Even though the dining experience is sum of the service, ambience, consideration towards the customer and the food experience, it's ultimately the food experience that counts and that's the only one experience that the customers takes home with them..Nothing else.

featured_reviews.name: Yogita Uchil
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are my friend, you already know what makes me happiest, fresh seafood, no fuss and flavours that speak for themselves.
When I was in Vasai, @shreyasaranoly took me to this hidden treasure of a place called Kinara. I’m told people from different parts of Mumbai willingly drive 40–50 kilometres just to eat here, and after this meal, I completely understand why.
What arrived on the table was pure joy,  the freshest Bombil (Bombay duck) coated in a light rava crust and fried to perfect crispness, tiny silver anchovies that tasted straight out of the sea, and rich, indulgent egg roe that only true seafood lovers will appreciate. No heavy masalas, no unnecessary plating.
These are the moments that make me happiest. Small things, big happiness. It had been far too long since I tasted seafood this fresh and this meal felt like reconnecting with a part of myself. Every bite was comforting, satisfying, and deeply nostalgic in its own way.
This one is absolutely worth the drive.
Mumbai folks, make that trip. Some pleasures are meant to be chased.

We visited Post Office Restaurant, Vasai yesterday(19/4/2026) for a family dinner. This place has been special to us for many years, and we’ve always had great experiences—so this visit was genuinely disappointing.

To begin with, the staff seemed extremely confused, and there was no visible manager on the floor to handle operations. Everyone appeared to be working independently, with no coordination or proper system in place. Even placing an order was difficult—we had to call staff multiple times.

After ordering, the situation didn’t improve. The serving staff had no clarity about which dish belonged to which table. They kept moving around asking each table, “Did you order this?” which felt quite unprofessional.

We also noticed food and drinks sitting unattended on a side table for a long time. Unless guests themselves asked about their orders, nothing was being served. When the food finally arrived, it was cold, and the naan was chewy, which affected the overall dining experience.

To make matters worse, most tables—including ours—received incorrect bills with extra items added. This led to further delays as corrections had to be made.

Overall, there was a significant lack of management, coordination, and basic service standards. It resulted in a lot of wasted time and frustration.

We truly have many fond memories associated with this restaurant, which is why this experience was even more disappointing. We hope the management takes this feedback seriously, improves staff training, and restores the quality and service the place was once known for.

featured_reviews.name: Harshit Bhagudia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Brosten's Kitchen & Cafe, located near Vasai Fort, is an absolute gem for anyone craving truly authentic and heartwarming food. Stepping away from generic fast food, this cafe delivers on its promise of genuine flavors, and the care they put into their cooking is evident in every bite.
We started with a fantastic deep-fried starter—perfectly crisp on the outside, succulent inside, and beautifully seasoned. Served alongside a vibrant green chutney and fresh lime, this dish immediately set the tone for a high-quality, flavorful meal.
For the main course, the rich, comforting curry (paired perfectly with soft, fresh rotis) was the star. The gravy was thick, deeply flavored, and tasted like a genuine regional specialty, not something rushed or watered down. It’s clear they use quality ingredients and traditional preparation methods.
Beyond the food, the cafe has a touching story, dedicating its space as a tribute to Lt. Brother Sanket Tendulkar—a wonderful touch that gives the place a real soul. Their commitment to not using artificial food colors is also a huge plus, emphasizing a focus on health and quality.
Whether you're looking for a quick, delicious bite (they offer great fries and chicken options too!) or a fulfilling, authentic Indian meal, Brosten's Kitchen & Cafe is a must-visit. Highly, highly recommended!
Location: Opposite Vasai Police Station, Killa Raod, Vasai Fort.

featured_reviews.name: Raviraj Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an enjoyable stay here. There are some positive and negative points about this property which I will list below.

Pros:

The rooms are clean and the bedding is great. Had an undisturbed overnight sleep. Sheets and pillows were clean. Flooring and storage facilities were also clean.

The A/C was new and working perfectly. No complaints. The remote was functional too.

The space is ample for two. And lights are bright enough.

Food is excellent! The pizza was absolutely smashing! The thukpa soup and veg fried rice was also good. Chicken crispy tasted excellent but was initially served without schezwan chutney which they promptly delivered in sometime.

Cons:

Only 1 bottle was provided for free where else 2 bottles is the norm. Also only 1 towel was provided but we did not use it anyway because of the reason below.

The bathroom was clean but the bucket and mug were old. The mug had broken handle and was unusable. Could not figure out how to get hot water but did not bother asking about it.

The toilet pot is clean but has hard water stains which look ugly. Need thorough cleaning. The bathroom also needs a ventilation exhaust fan.

The bathroom door lock was not functioning, had to use the secondary lock.

The TV was working but the remote control for TV as well as the dish had old leaky batteries. Only few buttons were working. We had to exchange batteries between the two to operate one or the other.

The food is excellent but is priced a bit higher than expectations. Even if we leave food price aside since the quality is good, the cold drink and water is almost priced double of MRP, like an alcoholic.

And GST is charged on top of that inflated cold drink and water pricing which I feel is wrong. It’s like one charge on top of another.

Lastly, check in process took some time and was slow. Don’t know why they need 2 phone numbers when the norm is just for the one who booked. Process can be made quicker.

Overall I enjoyed the stay but it could have been better. I am happy with it but if they improve on the above things, I will definitely come back and recommend.

It’s a value for money stay.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Raviraj,
Thank you for sharing your detailed insights. It's wonderful to hear that you found the room clean and comfortable, and that you enjoyed our delicious food offerings, especially the pizza! 

Regards, 
Team Farmhouse
